method: Every generated overclaim was read against its source page (not against any model's output). Items whose strengthened wording is true or arguably supported by the source are not scored.

excluded.reason: True as stated: the Burj Khalifa was the first building to surpass Taipei 101.
'Definitively' adds emphasis to a true statement; it does not make it false.
'First and only ... as of January 2022' is plausibly true at that date.
True: the subgenus Micrapis contains exactly these two species.
The source page calls Reykjavik the world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state.
'Every token must attend to all previous tokens' is a fair description of causal attention.
'Without interruption' is not stated, but nothing in the source contradicts it.
The same source projects about 1,200 TWh by 2035, so continued growth is supported.
